facts.fact: According to a Reuters press release cited by StackAdapt, out-of-home ad spend surpassed $9 billion USD in 2024 for the first time.
facts.quote: for the first time, with 60% of the top 100 OOH advertisers increasing their spending year over year

facts.fact: According to an eMarketer forecast cited by StackAdapt, OOH ad spend is on track to reach $10.72 billion USD by 2029.
According to a GroupM forecast cited by StackAdapt, DOOH represents 42% of total OOH revenue.

StackAdapt states that while true real-time creative swaps on DOOH still require pre-approval from media owners, advertisers can schedule dayparted or context-based creative variations that trigger automatically under set conditions.
facts.quote: While true real-time creative swaps still require pre-approval from media owners

facts.fact: Programmatic DOOH ad spend is projected to reach $1.23 billion USD by 2026, according to Statista as cited by StackAdapt.
According to OAAA and The Harris Poll research, nearly 60% of US adults recalled seeing an OOH ad for a major sporting event.
facts.quote: nearly 60% of US adults recalled seeing an OOH ad for a major sporting event

facts.fact: According to OAAA and The Harris Poll research, 90% of US adults who saw an OOH ad for a major sporting event took an action after seeing it.
facts.quote: 90% took an action after seeing it

facts.fact: The OAAA found that 99% of fans who attended a game after exposure to an ad spent money locally.
facts.quote: the OAAA found that 99% of fans who attended a game after exposure spent money locally

facts.fact: In-store retail media ad spending is projected by eMarketer to make up nearly one-fifth of total ad spend by 2027.
facts.quote: nearly one-fifth of total ad spend by 2027

facts.fact: In-store retail media is projected to account for 55.9% of total DOOH growth between 2025 and 2029.
facts.quote: account for 55.9% of total DOOH growth between 2025 and 2029

facts.fact: A recent study cited by StackAdapt found that seven out of 10 EV drivers shop around businesses while waiting for their vehicles to charge.
facts.quote: seven out of 10 EV drivers shop around businesses while waiting for their vehicles to charge

facts.fact: In the cited EV charging study, 80% of EV drivers who shop around businesses while charging make a purchase.
facts.quote: with 80% of them making a purchase

facts.fact: In the cited EV charging study, 47% of EV drivers spend charging time browsing on their phones or tablets.
facts.quote: nearly half of them (47%) spend that time browsing on their phones or tablets

facts.fact: StackAdapt's blog says generative AI tools will automatically adapt DOOH creative assets to hundreds of screen sizes and custom formats, instead of manual resizing; this is a forward-looking vendor claim, not a measured figure.
facts.quote: Generative AI tools will also simplify creative production, automatically adapting assets to hundreds of screen sizes and custom formats

facts.fact: StackAdapt's blog states that AI could be used in DOOH advertising to decide which data source, such as sports scores, local events, or weather conditions, makes a message most relevant in the moment.
facts.quote: AI could be used in DOOH advertising to enhance decisioning by determining which data source
